_readme: §PER-CITY-MEASUREMENTS (L-662) — the three EXPENSIVE C63 axes (LEGISLATION 25 · ENVELOPE 20 ·
HEIGHTS 10 = 55 % of the ratified weight) are AUDITS, not config reads, so computeScorecard.mjs
will not score them without a committed, reviewable measurement record. Absent ⇒ not-assessed.
⚠ `status: 'measured'` is the ONLY key that unlocks an axis. Never set it to make a number appear.
⚠ Every figure below is CITED to an artefact or a probe. INV-3: cited derivation, never a guess.
⚠⚠ THIS RECORD REPORTS THREE ZEROS AND ONE NEAR-ZERO, AND EVERY ONE OF THEM IS AN IMPROVEMENT
OVER `not-assessed`. Madrid's board previously read 71.0 % over 45 % of the ratified weight —
a headline computed by measuring only the axes that were cheap. Scoring the expensive ones
honestly moves the composite DOWN and the assessed weight UP. That direction is the point:
C63 §1.5 / L-656 — a cited refusal is a correct answer, and a smaller number over a larger
denominator is a better measurement than a larger number over a smaller one.
⚠ WHY THIS FILE DID NOT EXIST UNTIL NOW. `CLOSURE-REGISTER.md` row 9 deliberately withheld it:
the tool hard-coded the string 'of the PRIVATE-BUILDABLE denominator (L-656)' into every ENVELOPE
derivation, and Madrid's shares are of Norma-Zonal-GOVERNED land, so writing this file would have
generated a FALSE derivation string. That was the correct call, and the fix was to the TOOL, not
to the number: scorecard 1.2 §STATED-DENOMINATOR now prints the record's own denominator and
labels the substitution loudly. Row 9 stays OPEN — the substitution is disclosed, not resolved.

envelope.denominator: Norma-Zonal-GOVERNED land = 149,577,170 m² (server-side SHAPE.STArea() over all 34 AMB_TX_ETIQ codes, VERIFICATION.md V14). ⚠ SUBSTITUTED — this is NOT the ratified L-656 private-buildable set; PG_ORDENACION/4 Ámbitos de Ordenación is polyline-with-OBJECTID-only (V18), so the private-buildable census cannot be derived. Every figure here is an UPPER BOUND on the L-656 measure (CLOSURE-REGISTER row 9, OPEN).
note: ⭐ SIG-M2 SIGNED 2026-08-02 by the founder (Doctrine B, ADR-0280). `MADRID_NZ1_CERTIFIED` is `true`
again — this time on a signature `l449CertificationGates.test.ts` OPENS AND READS from
sources/VERIFICATION.md, not on a commit that cited itself. NZ 1 returns to `estimated-ruleset`.
⚠ The value is the same 0.4 the machine flip produced; what differs is that deleting the signature
now turns the build red. That distinction is the entire content of L-449.
Three NON-OVERLAPPING slices covering 100 % of the stated denominator, so measuredShare = 1.0.
60.458 %  Norma Zonal 3, Volumetría Específica → `not-determined`. THE PLAN DECLINES TO STATE
AN ENVELOPE: Art. 8.3.1 «se ha agotado el aprovechamiento urbanístico» and «sin
imponer un nuevo modelo». A cited `derived-plan` refusal ships TODAY, gate-independent.
11.695 %  Norma Zonal 1 → `not-determined` as of 2026-08-01. IT WAS `estimated-ruleset` UNTIL
TODAY, and this is the only figure in the record that MOVED DOWN. See below.
27.847 %  the 23 packed PGOUM-97 zones (NZ 4·5·7·8·9) → `no-pack` for scoring purposes: the
pack EXISTS with 282 cited records, but MADRID_ENVELOPE_VERIFIED is `false`, so every
parcel receives `madridPgoum97UnverifiedRefusal` and NO number reaches the panel, the
massing or `site.updateZoning`. Scoring a tier for numbers nobody can see would be the
authored-but-unwired fabrication (L-651). Under SIG-M1 as currently scoped this slice
becomes 17.248 % at `pipeline-extracted-unverified` (0.1) ⇒ the axis would read 1.7 %.
`MADRID_NZ1_CERTIFIED` shipped `= true` and published a clipped published-footprint envelope over
11.695 % of this denominator. Its docstring credited «the L-608 sign-off, 2026-07-25». `git log -S`
puts the flip in ONE commit — `3e571724`, «fix(madrid): ship the parcel ring on compound COEF_Z +
flip NZ1 gate ON», `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8` — and `sources/VERIFICATION.md §3 “Signed off
(legal)”` is EMPTY. A MACHINE OPENED ITS OWN PUBLICATION GATE and cited the commit that opened it
as the authority. De-certified 2026-08-01 pending a human yes/no on SIG-M2. ⇒ Madrid's ENVELOPE
axis is a MEASURED 0 %, not the ≤4.7 % every Madrid document reported this week.
⚠ The de-certification is not a claim that NZ 1's footprint is wrong. The footprint is real
published municipal geometry and SIG-M2 may well be answered «reading geometry is not a
transcription, no L-449 signature is owed» — which would restore this slice legitimately. What was
unacceptable was an open gate resting on an authority that did not exist.
called NZ 3 «the only structurally impossible category». That is WRONG, and it is 60.458 % of the
city. Art. 8.3.5.3.a).i) verbatim: «La nueva edificación deberá inscribirse dentro de la ENVOLVENTE
EXTERIOR DEL EDIFICIO EXISTENTE, constituida por sus cubiertas, fachadas exteriores y, en su caso,
medianeras, y respetará la SUPERFICIE TOTAL EDIFICADA DEL MISMO.» ⇒ NZ 3 states a computable
envelope for its only new-construction pathway; PRYZM lacks the DATUM, not the rule.
⚠ PROBE P3 RUN 2026-08-02 — MEASURED NEGATIVE. PG_ANALISIS_EDIFICACION is live (HTTP 200, 13
layers) and carries NO ATTRIBUTES: layer 4 `Edificaciones` polyline/OBJECTID-only, layer 2 `Fondo
máximo…` polyline/OBJECTID-only, layer 12 `Fondo` POLYGON/OBJECTID-only. A drawing, not a table.
⇒ the existing-GFA datum is not obtainable municipally. Catastro built-area is the next candidate.
⚠⚠ DO NOT PACK NZ 3 FROM NZ 5 / NZ 8. Art. 8.3.5.3.a).i) does let the substituted volume borrow NZ
5 (edificación aislada) and NZ 8 grado 4º (vivienda unifamiliar) ocupación+altura — but ONLY under
the condition stated immediately above it: «No sobrepasar la edificabilidad permitida, entendida
ésta como la superficie edificada total del edificio existente». Borrowing the parameters WITHOUT
that ceiling is the L-616 mechanism-A over-statement across 60.458 % of Madrid. A SOLID must
intersect ALL derived constraints; an envelope that ignores one ceiling is worse than none.
⇒ `not-determined` is the CORRECT score for this slice, not a failure to be engineered away.
§NZ3-ARTICLE-VERDICT (2026-08-02, L-678) — SUPERSEDES the §NZ3-IS-DATA-GATED note of 2026-08-01,
which was WRONG. Art. 8.3.1 GOVERNS: «se ha agotado el aprovechamiento urbanístico» … «sin imponer
un nuevo modelo». Art. 8.3.5 is an *obras* regime under «Sección Primera: Condiciones de edificación
del Grado 1º» that PRESUPPOSES an existing building and takes that building's own envelope and built
area as the measure — 8.3.1 restated operationally, not a competing grant. Five verbatim anchors in
the chapter; vacant land is «espacios libres SIN APROVECHAMIENTO URBANÍSTICO» (8.3.3.1.b); the only
vacant-land new-build route is «con carácter excepcional … enteramente subterránea» (8.3.5.3.b).
⇒ 60.458 % of Madrid is ANSWERED, permanently. `not-determined` is a DETERMINATION, not a gap, and
the tier is correct under C63 §1.5 / L-656. This slice can never rise, and it should not.
⚠ The Fondo geometry located in PG_ANALISIS_EDIFICACION MUST NOT be bound to NZ 3: ADR-0283 —
'where evidence is incomplete OR LEGALLY INSUFFICIENT, PRYZM returns Unknown rather than inferring
entitlement'. And measured extent would have capped any claim at ~4.9 % of the city anyway (layer 2),
while layer 12 «Fondo» is ONE municipality-wide polygon — a cartographic background, not a datum.

legislation.source: docs/04-reference/jurisdictions/es/es-md/28079-madrid/sources/VERIFICATION.md §3 (EMPTY) + V13 (34-code inventory, VERIFIED-LIVE) + V19–V21 (corpus custody + quote concordance)
note: DENOMINATOR = 34, the calificación families the LIVE sigma.madrid.es NORMAS_ZONALES/0 layer
returns over the 28079 extent — unfiltered `returnCountOnly` = 34, groupBy = 34 groups × n=1
(V13, VERIFIED-LIVE and EXHAUSTIVE). NOT the 23 we packed. Scoring cited/authored would report
100 % — the 'Barcelona-borrow' trap C63 §3 Axis 2 names.
⚠ NUMERATOR = 0, AND IT IS A MEASURED 0, NOT A MISSING MEASUREMENT. `VERIFICATION.md §3 “Signed
off (legal)”` has no rows. Madrid holds 282 machine-extracted records carrying article + apartado
+ PDF page + verbatim quote, and NO human has re-read one line of them. L-449: transcribing an
ordinance is a legal act and a pack cannot sign its own transcription. An agent cannot raise this
number; only a Spanish-planning-literate human reading Título 8 can.
⚠ documentInRepo FLIPPED false → TRUE ON 2026-08-01, and this is the substantive change of the
turn (L-674 flagged it as load-bearing; CLOSURE-REGISTER row 15(i)). The primary source is now at
`corpus/pdf/COMPENDIO_MPG_NNUU_24-09-2025_PGOUM-97.pdf` — 25,735,355 bytes, 626 pp, sha256
1A3AA172B7ABE092F03E58FB2AFC26C87020B907887F919CEE20002E5FC4D0B5, PDF `title` metadata
«COMPENDIO MPG NNUU (24-09-2025)». It is the transparencia 24-09-2025 consolidation, NOT the
superseded 07-07-2025 geoportal edition (the V10 hazard). Madrid is now the SECOND Spanish city
after Barcelona whose cited quotes can be re-read offline; Córdoba and Murcia still cannot.
⚠ It remains `carácter informativo` (V3) — the OFFICIAL text is the BOCM publication — so holding
it does not make a signature on it a signature on the law. It makes one POSSIBLE.
§MADRID-QUOTE-CONCORDANCE (V21): all 1,321 `verbatim` strings in `extracted/*.json` were
mechanically re-read against that PDF — 992 present on the page cited, 40 spanning from it, 0
found on a wrong page, 0 fabricated. ⚠ THIS DOES NOT MOVE THIS AXIS BY ONE FIELD AND MUST NOT BE
REPORTED AS IF IT DID: a concordance check proves a string was COPIED from the document. Whether
the extracted NUMBER correctly INTERPRETS that string is the reading L-449 requires, and a second
machine pass is not a human one. It is recorded because it removes 'the quotes may be fabricated'
from the risk register — nothing more.
⚠ supersessionChecked: FALSE. No search has been made for a *modificación puntual* affecting any
Título 8 article the pack cites, and no `effectiveDate` is established for any of them; the pack
carries only `readFrom`. ⚠ The PDF's own amendment footnotes are now readable in-repo (e.g. Art.
8.8.9 carries «modificado por la MPG 00/343, BOCM 27.11.2023»), so this is newly TRACTABLE — it is
not done. CLOSURE-REGISTER row 14.

The 269 `tagged` are OSM-surveyed heights, not MDS samples. 76.4 % of Madrid's context buildings
render the FABRICATED 9 m default (median height 9.0 m, which is the default itself).
⚠ THIS RECORD IS A PRE-BAKE BASELINE, DELIBERATELY. A national buildings bake was IN FLIGHT on
this SHA and `tools/context-bake/` was NOT touched by this turn. Re-probe and update this block
after it publishes; do NOT edit these counts to predict the outcome (§SIZE-IS-NOT-PROVENANCE — a
green bake is precisely what L-658 produced while shipping nothing).
⚠ The bbox is the probe's ±0.06° window about Puerta del Sol (40.4168,-3.7038), i.e. central
Madrid, NOT the municipal boundary. Comparisons with any other city must use the same window.
